name: Takada Nobuchika
source:
Nobuchina's older sister. She left home when she began university and became a lawyer. When she gets angry, she slips back into talking like those in the house she grew up in and this often scares people.

“Yes. There’s a 99% chance you’ll be prosecuted.”
